name: Luanti
tagline: (formerly Minetest) is an open source voxel game-creation platform with easy modding and game creation
description: Luanti (formerly Minetest) is an open source voxel game-creation platform with easy modding and game creation

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/luanti:5.18.0@sha256:77932c3828dd5943cc46f8b03dcb1837ed184f809816518224c88c533da5f9f0
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      CLI_ARGS: ''
    ports:
      - target: 30000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: udp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config/.minetest
        target: /config/.minetest
